Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Phase 1: Foundation — SolShot branding, DB models, weapon trim, server setup

- Add mongoose, @solana/web3.js, jsonwebtoken, cors to server deps
- Add MongoDB connection with graceful fallback in server/index.js
- Create User model \(wallet-based identity, stats tracking\)
- Create Match model \(room state, rounds, turns, player data\)
- Refactor socket rooms from in-memory array to DB-backed with cache
- Trim weapon array.js to 13 launch weapons \(IDs: 0,1,2,3,4,5,7,9,10,11,12,15,16\)
- Update branding: title to SolShot, remove Kongregate/GD SDK references
- Point client socket to localhost:5001 with REACT_APP_SERVER_URL env var
- Create server/.env.example template
- Add .env to .gitignore

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Phase 2: Server-authoritative physics, match state machine, turn validation

- Server physics engine \(physics.js\): trajectory, impact, damage, terrain deformation
  extracted from client-side Phaser physics for exact parity
- Match state machine \(match.js\): LOBBY→WEAPON_SHOP→BATTLE→ROUND_END→SETTLING
  with action validation and turn management
- Socket handler: new ''fire'' event \(server computes shot\), ''requestTerrain'' event,
  turn validation, round/match end detection
- Client type3: listeners for turnResult, fireRejected, terrainGenerated, roundEnd, matchEnd
- Legacy relay events preserved for backward compatibility
- Integration test: 26 tests covering full 2-client match flow \(all passing\)
- DB operations guarded with isDbConnected\(\) for graceful no-DB operation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Phase 3: Gold economy, weapon shop with costs, shop timer, HUD Gold display

- Gold service \(gold.js\): startingGold\(1000\), earn rates \(+15/HP damage,
  +200 kill bonus, +300 round win\), spendGold with validation
- Weapon catalog \(Weapon.js\): all 13 launch weapons with tiers and Gold costs
  \(Free→Standard→Tactical→Rare→Epic→Legendary, 0-2500 Gold\)
- Server buyWeapon handler: validates Gold balance, deducts cost, adds to
  inventory, notifies opponent, rejects duplicates/unaffordable
- Shop phase flow: both players ready → shopPhase event with weapon catalog,
  Gold balances, 30s timer → buyWeapon/shopDone → shopEnd with inventories
- Client weapon shop \(scene-5/type3\): Gold display, tier-colored costs,
  affordability greying, buy-on-click, opponent purchase notifications
- HUD Gold display: centered Gold counter updated via turnResult events
- Gold broadcasts: turnResult includes goldEarned + goldBalance,
  roundEnd/matchEnd include goldBalance for both players
- Integration tests: 44 tests \(18 new Gold tests\), all passing
- Match state: added lobby→battle transition for weapon shop skip
- Legacy draft-pick system preserved as fallback

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Phase 4: Wallet integration, SOL wager system, match settlement

- Add Solana wallet adapter \(Phantom + Solflare\) with WalletContext
- Add wallet auth middleware \(signed message + JWT verification\)
- Add Solana service \(balance check, settlement calc, escrow stubs\)
- Add wager selection UI in scene-3 with tier buttons \(0-0.5 SOL\)
- Add wager display in room list \(scene-4\) with wallet validation
- Server verifies wallet balance on joinRoom for wagered matches
- Match settlement: 90% winner, 7% treasury, 3% ops on matchEnd
- Disconnect/leave during battle triggers forfeit settlement
- Result screen shows SOL won/lost overlay with transaction info
- 58 integration tests passing \(wager room, free play, settlement, forfeit\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
